evidence_required: commencement notice OR 7-day notice submitted to building control authority
compliance with applicable Building Control Act 1990 regulations
qualifying_work: construction of apartment complex/building or relevant part
extension increasing floor area by at least 25%
change of use creating qualifying new apartment complex/building or qualifying floor area

effect_seed: For a qualifying property, the ordinary 2% ceiling does not apply to annual rent increases; the increase is linked to CPI, subject to the statutory conditions.

source_chain.source: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

decision_states.YES: Exception conditions evidenced; continue to full legal composition.
decision_states.NO: Evidence indicates the qualifying exception does not apply; continue with ordinary applicable rule.
decision_states.UNKNOWN: Do not assume qualification. Request or verify the required Building Control evidence.
decision_states.CONFLICT: Facts/evidence conflict; stop definitive calculation and flag for review.

important_guardrail: Apartment age alone is not sufficient evidence of qualification. The legally relevant construction commencement/building-control evidence must be checked.
scope_limit: This is a verified rule seed, not a complete legal determination or complete treatment of every exception.
